issues.title: [BUG] Rapid memory leak with amendments skull piles
issues.body: *please make sure you are using the latest ETF version before submitting an issue, you might also find a dev build fixing this issue already on my discord https://discord.com/invite/rURmwrzUcz in the #dev-blog channel* **Describe the issue** - What happened? Java application memory rapidly increases until the O.S. kills the application for O.O.M. This is notably not the the normal minecraft heap. It doesn't increase the amount of memory used in the ingame f3 memory readout. Memory consumption scales with the amount of skull piles used. You can easily use several GB in a matter of seconds with enough skulls, potentially freezing a client's computer if used maliciously. - What were you doing when it happened? Utilizing [amendments](https://modrinth.com/mod/amendments) skull piles with custom player heads of different skins stacked on top of each other. Loading this structure with a structure block will display the issue in your world easily: https://github.com/ShadowzOfTheDark/notfilesharing/blob/main/heads_stack.nbt This issue does not occur with normal player heads. Only ETF, Amendments, and Moonlight Lib are needed for this issue to show. - Does this issue also occur with OptiFine? Happens without optifine installed. **Screenshots** Notice the java application is using a whopping 20GB while the memory used by the game has only allocated 2200MB The setup that causes the memory leak. **Crash log** https://gist.github.com/ShadowzOfTheDark/abb5b389ed30cd424130340a80083a46 **Your setup: (please complete the following information):** - Minecraft version: 1.21.1 - ModLoader: Neoforge 21.1.255 - ETF Version: 7.2.5 - Does the issue persist with only ETF installed? Yes - Have you checked the FAQ in the Readme, or Discord, to see if it is a known issue? Yes

issues.title: ETF skin features (emissive eyes / blinking) are not applied to the local player in third-person view (F5) on Minecraft 26.1
issues.body:
**Submit to:** https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/issues

## Environment

- Minecraft **26.1.2**, Fabric Loader 0.19.5
- **entity_texture_features 7.2.1-fabric-26.1** (2026-09-02)
- entity_model_features 3.3.5-fabric-26.1
- Iris 1.11.3+mc26.1.2 (+ Sodium 0.9.1)
- Resource packs: FreshAnimations 1.10.4, FA+Player v1.1, FA+Player_Expressions v1.2, FA+All_Extensions v1.8, EFA 1.10.4 Hotfix 3
- Mods present but verified irrelevant (issue persists with each disabled): firstperson, perspective_api, CameraOverhaul, Female Gender Mod (wildfire_gender)
- The exact same ETF/EMF versions and the same resource packs on **1.21.11** work correctly

## Expected behaviour

A player skin that declares ETF texture features (emissive eyes + blinking, skin reported as `Found Player {name} with ETF texture features in skin`) should show the emissive/blinking eyes everywhere the player model is rendered.

## Actual behaviour

In **third-person (F5) view of the local player**, the ETF skin features are not applied:
- Eyes are missing (the base skin has no eye pixels there — the eyes only exist in the ETF feature/emissive layer), so the face appears blank.
- The same skin/player rendered through the **GUI path (inventory paper doll, HUD)** shows the eyes correctly.
- Other entities with normal skins are unaffected (no features to apply), so the issue only visibly affects players using ETF-feature skins viewed in third person.

## Key code-level observation

In `MixinPlayerEntityRenderer#etf$getTexture` (injected into `AvatarRenderer#getTextureLocation(AvatarRenderState)`):

```java
var state = ((HoldsETFRenderState) playerRenderState).etf$getState();
if (!(state != null && state.entity() instanceof AbstractClientPlayer ...)) return;
```

The feature lookup requires the **ETF render-state wrapper to carry the player entity** (`state.entity()`). On the world/third-person render path of the local player (LevelRenderer → EntityRenderDispatcher → AvatarRenderer), the wrapper does not provide the entity, so this hook returns early, `etf$ETFPlayerTexture` stays null, the base texture is not remapped and `ETFPlayerFeatureRenderer` renders nothing. On the GUI path (createRenderState/extractRenderState with the entity at hand) the wrapper has the entity and features work — which matches the GUI-vs-world difference exactly.

## What I tried as a local workaround (partial)

Injecting my own hook on the same `getTextureLocation` RETURN point (lower mixin priority, after ETF's hook): when the returned texture equals the local player's skin texture and `etf$ETFPlayerTexture` is still null, call `ETFManager.getInstance().getPlayerTexture(player, texture)` myself, install it on the renderer field and return the remapped base texture. Result: the remapped texture is applied (log confirms), but the eyes are **still missing** — so some further per-render context (render-layer modification / emissive pass gated on the mounted ETF state?) is also missing on this path.

## Secondary issue found on the same build (26.1 only)

CEM `properties` files that use OptiFine **weighted/heighted random syntax** fail to parse on 26.1 and are ignored (26 files, e.g. `witch.properties`, `creeper.properties` with `weights.2=8 1 4` / `heights.2=0-50` / multi-model `models.1=1 4`):

```
[ETF]: property number "1. in file "minecraft:optifine/cem/creeper.properties. failed to read.
[ETF]: Ignoring properties file that failed to load any cases @ minecraft:optifine/cem/creeper.properties
```

Simple properties (single model, `blocks.2=...` only, e.g. `cow.properties`, `pig.properties`) load fine. Same packs + same ETF 7.2.1 on 1.21.11 load all of them (0 failures). This breaks FA's mob variant textures on 26.1.

## Log excerpt

```
[ETF]: Found Player {Mao_Yu_Official} with ETF texture features in skin.
```

(no errors besides the CEM parse failures above)

Happy to provide a video capture or test builds if useful.

issues.title: [BUG] ETF breaks when encountering non-.png assets
issues.body:
Breaks isn't really the right word, but I didn't want to do a lengthy title.

The TLDR is that `ETFTexture` assumes that every texture being loaded is a `.png`, which is never necessarily true.
When another mod attempts to load in a non-png resource, ETF attempts to locate an `_enchant.png` suffix resource by swapping out the .png with the suffix.
If the resource isn't a .png, it still returns a valid resource location, which is just the original resource location, which then causes ETF to assume a false-positive.
This then causes every non-png texture to be enchanted, blink, etc..

I'm not going to link every occurance of this because it's all throughout the file and you can see the pattern:

https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/blob/a7fc2a1172264899a3fe4058c9958a2c42269920/src/main/java/traben/entity_texture_features/features/texture_handlers/ETFTexture.java#L324-L326

The solution is an easy one - either check if the resource is a png explicitly and return out if it's not, or check if the `thisIdentifier` matches the `possibleEnchantIdentifier` before looking for the resource and returning out if it's the same.

This applies to all versions since you introduced this feature, and it's basically the same fix for all of them

issues.title: [BUG] "Datapack-Defined Biomes Not Recognized"
issues.body:
Hi there, not sure if this is technically a bug or more of a request/suggestion for additional compatibility.

I'm working with ETF and EMF, as well as a couple other OptiFine feature replacement mods, in a world with a fair amount of custom biomes that are defined by datapacks. I wanted to have some random entity textures that only show up in certain biomes, and was able to use vanilla biomes, but not the custom ones, no matter how they were namespaced in the resource pack properties file. I was able to get custom biomes working with Skyboxify (which I recognize is another mod with different maintainers, but I'm pulling my info on it from the same OptiDocs sources as I use for ETF), but the same syntax isn't working here. I've tried with multiple different mobs and different combinations of properties, it does seem like they never recognize the custom biomes no matter what.

I see that the documentation's wording is that "modded" biomes are supported, and these technically aren't modded. Is this an oversight which may be fixed/given support in the future, or is there a particular reason why this functionality doesn't exist? Any input appreciated!

This is on Minecraft 26.2, running ETF 7.1.1 and EMF 3.2.6 on Fabric 0.19.3. First noticed in a pack with other mods (mostly utility and QoL tools like Axiom/Sodium), but the issue does persist with only ETF.

issues.title: [BUG] MixinIdentifier causes dedicated server crash due to client-only class reference
issues.body:
When running the mod entity_texture_features on a NeoForge dedicated server (version 1.21.11, or might other versions also), the server fails to start with a NoClassDefFoundError for net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen. The crash is triggered because MixinIdentifier is listed under the "mixins" array in entity_texture_features.mixins.json, causing it to be loaded on the server even though the mixin directly references a client-only class.

_Steps to Reproduce_
- Set up a NeoForge dedicated server.
- Place entity_texture_features-...-neoforge.jar into the server’s mods folder.
- Start the server.

_Expected Behavior_
The server starts without errors; client-only mixins are not loaded on the server.

_Actual Behavior_
The server crashes during bootstrap with:


```text
java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: net/minecraft/client/gui/screens/Screen
    at net.minecraft.resources.Identifier.handler$...$etf$illegalPathOverride(...)
    ...
```
Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: Attempted to load class net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen which is not present on the dedicated server
Root Cause
In entity_texture_features.mixins.json, MixinIdentifier is placed inside "mixins" (which is applied on both client and server) instead of inside "client".

The relevant snippet from the configuration file:

```json
"mixins": [
    "MixinIdentifier",
    ...
],
"client": [
    ...
]
```
MixinIdentifier (traben.entity_texture_features.mixin.mixins.MixinIdentifier) uses net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen in its code, which does not exist on the dedicated server. Moving this entry to the "client" array completely resolves the crash.

_Suggested Fix_
Change entity_texture_features.mixins.json so that "MixinIdentifier" is listed under "client" instead of "mixins":

```json
"mixins": [
    //only server-safe mixins...
],
"client": [
    "MixinIdentifier",
    ...
]
```
_Additional Context_

Mod version tested: ETF(any version) for NeoForge 1.21.11

No other mods are required to reproduce the crash.

The issue does not occur in single-player because the client environment is available.

Workaround: end users can move the entry manually, but the fix should be made upstream to prevent server crashes for everyone.

issues.title: isCurrentlyRenderingEntity() hardcoded true on 1.21.9+ applies entity render-layer overrides to non-entity (GUI) rendering
issues.body:
https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/blob/a7fc2a1172264899a3fe4058c9958a2c42269920/src/main/java/traben/entity_texture_features/features/ETFRenderContext.java#L227

Because of this, ETFRenderContext.modifyRenderLayerIfRequired(RenderType) fires outside of entity rendering. ETF mixins getBuffer on both the vanilla buffer source (MixinVertexConsumerProvider$Immediate -MultiBufferSource.BufferSource) and ImmediatelyFast's (MixinBatchableBufferSource), so for any geometry drawn through any buffer source
GUI/HUD included, when an entity render-layer override is configured, ETF rewrites any textured render type (value instanceof ETFRenderLayerWithTexture) to RenderTypes.entityTranslucent(texture).

issues.body: **Describe the issue** When Iris is installed, it causes custom player models' Emissive textures to not render when applied via `player.properties` The issue doesn't appear when setting the custom player model as the Default, or when Iris is not installed Pack structure *(Model applied via `player.properties`)*: ``` assets/minecraft/emf/cem/player player.properties player2.jem // fallback model player3.jem // custom model skin3.png skin3_e.png ``` `player.properties`: ``` models.1 = 3 textures.1 = 3 skins.1 = 3 # Assign by Player UUID nbt.1.UUID = raw:[I;1270458458,-814531213,-1861616684,1002402629] # Fallback models.2 = 2 ``` `player3.jem` has `skin3.png` as `texture` parameter Note: Neither `textures` nor `skins` parameters in `player.properties` seem to do anything in relation to player models The textures are only applied if they're specified by the `texture` parameter in the model file Pack structure *(Model set as Default)*: ``` assets/minecraft/emf/cem player.jem // custom model skin.png skin_e.png ``` `player.jem` has `skin.png` as `texture` parameter **Screenshots** With ETF + EMF + Sodium + Iris installed, model applied via `player.properties`: With ETF + EMF + Sodium + Iris installed, model set as Default: With just ETF + EMF + Sodium installed, model applied via `player.properties`: **Setup** - Minecraft version: `1.21.1` - ModLoader: `Neoforge` - ETF: `7.1`, EMF: `3.1.1` - Does the issue persist with only ETF installed? `No` - Have you checked the FAQ in the Readme, or Discord, to see if it is a known issue? `Yes`

issues.title: [SUGGESTION] "Legacy Modded Minecraft Versions"
issues.body:
Now I know it would be unreasonable to ask for you to back-port and maintain this mod it for **every** old Minecraft version, however there are a small handful of currently active modding versions that I think this mod should be back-ported to.
I'm suggesting just a simple bare-bones port to versions like 1.12.2, 1.7.10, 1.6.4 and any other common old modding versions, maybe fixing a few major bugs no more than once every couple of years if there are any. 
Due to the fact that Optifine is notoriously incompatible with many mods this and EMF are pretty much the only option for most dynamic texture-packs when used with mods these days, many of which used to rely on Optifine, which breaks down and crashes as soon as you _think_ about adding anything else to the game.

Does another mod also do this?
Optifine's the only one.

Does OptiFine do this?
Somewhat, but not with the mod compatibility focus ETF has.

issues.title: [SUGGESTION] Villager consistency with their zombified selves
issues.body:
Villagers and Zombie Villagers are treated by the game as separate entities, meaning that their random entity textures will be inconsistent between living and zombie forms. There could be an option to make it so that a Villager that spawns with, say, the texture villager2, will have the texture zombie_villager2 upon zombification, and the reverse for being cured.

I can't think of any other mod that does this, not even OptiFine has this feature as far as I know. It would be very useful for resource pack creators who want their randomized villagers to still look like themselves as a zombie.

issues.title: [BUG] Model issues when using Oculus
issues.body: **Describe the issue** When I use the Drodi's Illagers v5.2 resource pack, all the illagers have issues with models: the models are either completely invisible, or some parts of the models were missing (like witches' hands). It seems that the problem is on the ETF side. On the Drodi server, I was pointed to the [EntityModelShaderFix](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/entitymodelshaderfix) mod (thanks to brosquito). The mod's author tested this mod with the Gray's Mob Overhaul resource pack, and the mod fixed bugs with models from this resource pack. I tested the mod, and the mod also fixed bugs with models from Drodi's Illagers. All models with this mod are now displayed normally. According to the mod's author: > This mod fixes a bug where certain resource packs do not render the random parts of their models when Oclulus is present. The patch itself is present in ETF, but only enabled on Fabric+Iris shaders. This mod brings that patch across to Oculus so said parts render correctly. If the problem is on the ETF side, then it is worth including the changes from this mod in the ETF by default. Mod also fixes https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/issues/429 **Your setup:** - Minecraft version: 1.20.1 - ModLoader: Forge 47.4.10 - ETF Version: 7.0.8 - EMF Version: 3.0.10 - Resourcepacks: Drodi's Illagers x FA v5.2 and FreshAnimations v1.10.3 - Mods: Oculus 1.8.0 and Embeddium 0.3.31 **Screenshots**

**Describe the issue**

In a singeplayer world, open the mod's settings and go to the player skin features tool. Click the button that says "Add ETF features to skin". The game will immediately crash.

**Crash log**

Crash log: https://mclo.gs/yFHcHDi
Game log: https://mclo.gs/aXggfSc

**Your setup: (please complete the following information):**

- Minecraft version: 1.21.10
- ModLoader: Fabric
- ETF Version 7.0.5
- Does the issue persist with only ETF installed? Yes
- Have you checked the FAQ in the Readme, or Discord, to see if it is a known issue? Yes

issues.title: Crash prevention on forge 1.20.1 [Bug]
issues.body:
Describe your suggestion...
The entity_features mod seems to be fine in a dedicated server environment, just hoping to have this mod auto disable when seen in that environment for mod list parity.

Currently it just crashes the server as it is trying to access what it cannot.

issues.title: [BUG] .properties querks
issues.body:
A pack with a texture.propertie will only read the .propertie if above another pack with that same texture without the .propertie.
This is at least happening with texture overide, I did not had time to test with regular textures yet.

I have noticed that working on those two packs i put there as example. I've added a cape part with a texture override to a villager model. The pack without the .propertie juste has a cape.png as specified in the override (transparent texture). The other pack add many capes with a .propertie file to variate them depending of the texture suffixes of the villagers. It only work if the later is on top of the other.
Since there is no .propertie in the first pack, it should load it even if below. Concerning the cape textures, they are loaded, because when the pack is not above they randomise all the possible cape.pngs

[Pack without .propertie](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hermitcraft-villagers)
[Pack with the .propertie](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/semos-cape-addon)


On Fabric Latest EMF/ETF/Minecraft (and before ^^)

issues.title: ETF invoked/called too early causes crash.

issues.title: [BUG] Layer ordering issue with Iris/Oculus
issues.body:
**Describe the issue**

This is similar to issue #344 but is not being caused by Immediately-Fast. 

In having random entity textures with villagers, the layer order of the skin texture (villager.png) and the villager type layer (desert, swamp, etc.) will not prioritize correctly. It never affects all villagers at once and changes depending on the angle that I'm looking at the villagers. I found the above issue after joining the Discord when Google searching this issue produced no answers. However, I do not have Immediately-Fast installed and after performing a 50-50 mod test, I narrowed it down to Iris.

It is worth noting that:

- The issue did not persist when only Sodium (Iris' sole dependency) was active without Iris
- The issue was present when testing with NeOculus (both versions of 1.8.6) and Embeddium
- The issue did not persist when only Embeddium (NeOculus' dependency) was active without NeOculus
- The issue occurred both when shaders were on and off


**Screenshots**
I don't have my own screenshots to provide, mainly because I never managed to get the villagers to stay still long enough to catch it. However, issue #344 shows it well.

  - Issue also occurs on OptiFine, but didn't on older versions
  - As a partial workaround, EntityModelFeatures can be used to randomize the models instead, with each model being the vanilla one but using a different texture; one of the two glass cubes refuses to change its texture using this method though
- `entity/end_crystal/end_crystal_beam.png`
  - Does not randomize at all
  - OptiFine currently seems to not respect `end_crystal_beam.properties` and just does basic randomization instead
  - On older versions of OptiFine, `end_crystal_beam.properties` would randomize based on the beam's associated dragon rather than its associated crystal; it would be nice if EntityTextureFeatures could have an option to toggle between these
- `entity/enderdragon/dragon_exploding.png`
  - Does not randomize at all
  - Issue does not occur on OptiFine
- `entity/enderdragon/dragon_fireball.png`
  - Does not randomize at all
  - Issue also occurs on OptiFine, but didn't on older versions
- `entity/guardian_beam.png`
  - Does not randomize at all
  - Issue also occurs on OptiFine, but didn't on older versions
- `entity/minecart.png`
  - Does not randomize at all
  - Used to work fine but broke at some point in the past year
  - Issue also occurs on OptiFine, but didn't on older versions
- `entity/wither/wither_invulnerable.png`
  - Does not respect `wither.properties`; only works as expected if an additional `wither_invulnerable.properties` is created 
  - Issue does not occur on OptiFine

**Logs**

Latest game log: https://mclo.gs/Ge9SajB

**Setup**

- Minecraft version: 1.21.5
- Mod loader: Fabric 0.16.3
- ETF Version: 6.2.13
- The issues persist with only ETF installed.
- A couple of these (End Crystals, Minecarts) have already been mentioned elsewhere, but I figured it may be helpful to have everything together in one place
- Compared to OptiFine HD U J4 pre2 for Minecraft 1.21.4 because there is no version for Minecraft 1.21.5 yet.

issues.title: [SUGGESTION] Use ModifyReturnValue for MixinIdentifier
issues.body:
The [`MixinIdentifier`](https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/blob/fbab259e5f578520dca7ae7b53407a122e3aa7b3/common/src/main/java/traben/entity_texture_features/mixin/MixinIdentifier.java#L18) injector can cause high amounts of `CallbackInfoReturnable` allocations in conjunction with mods that create an `Identifier` on every tick. While it could be argued mods should be caching those, that's not something that's very easy to solve in the short term. I would recommend switching to [`ModifyReturnValue`](https://github.com/LlamaLad7/MixinExtras/wiki/ModifyReturnValue) from MixinExtras to alleviate the problem as well as to improve the compatibility of the injection overall.

I identified this through profiling, don't have a specific screenshot on hand but I can provide one if absolutely necessary.

issues.title: [BUG] Layer ordering issue on randomized textures using Immediately Fast
issues.body:
**Describe the issue**

Villagers have two textures applied to the same model: the villager's underwears/skin, and the biome-specific clothing. Where the two textures overlap, the clothing texture should take priority.

When Immediately-Fast is installed, the underwear sometimes takes priority over the clothing.

**Having multiple visible villagers with different random textures is required.** This doesn't occur if all visible villagers use the same texture. The bug will affect different villagers depending on your angle and position, but all villagers using the same texture will be affected (or unaffected) together in the same way. There seems to always be exactly one unaffected villager texture at any given time.

**Screenshots**
The pack here contains nothing but a `villager2.png` with inverted colours.

Only arms and legs are affected, because the torso clothings are on a different cube, slightly bigger and with different UVs. That part of the clothing doesn't compete with the underwear.

Blue villagers have their sleeves off :
![2025-01-05_12 30 39](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1a30811a-0794-4b4d-acf5-a39b5a39ab35)

With a different viewing angle, regular villagers are now the ones with their sleeves off :
![2025-01-05_12 30 38](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f27c0741-3d17-4d2e-8a75-4892ae9a62ed)


**Crash log**
Nothing noticeable in the log:
https://paste.ee/p/XDMOt

**Your setup:**

- Minecraft version: 1.21.4
- ModLoader: Fabric 0.16.9 + Fabric API 0.114.0
- ETF Version: 6.2.10
- EMF Version: 2.4.1
- Does the issue persist with only ETF installed? **No**
- Have you checked the FAQ in the Readme, or Discord, to see if it is a known issue? Yes

Noticed the same issue in MC 1.21.3, but not in MC 1.21.1

issues.title: [BUG] [PARITY] ETF incorrectly loads textures from optifine\random\entity
issues.body:
**Describe the issue**

When using random entities, placing `<entity>.png` in the `minecraft\optifine\random\entity\` folder, ETF will load this image, replacing the default `<entity>.png` from `minecraft\textures\entity\`. This is inconsistent with OptiFine behavior. OptiFine only loads the numerically identified textures (ie `<entity>2.png`), it never replaces the default image.

issues.title: [SUGGESTION] Support for non-integer values in the "range:" variation of the random entities feature's NBT rule
issues.body:
Describe your suggestion...
the NBT rule in random_entities.properties has multiple variations (raw: | regex: | etc.) and one of those is range: which checks for an integer value in a list. The problem is, many useful NBT values are of the "float" type, which cannot be checked by "range:".

Usage example: with Random Mob Sizes "ScaleFactor" NBT value (which is a float), textures could be applied based on entity size.

Does another mod also do this?
No.

Does OptiFine do this?
No.

issues.title: ETF Mod's blinking feature makes glowing transparent pixels flicker with 3D skin layers
issues.body:
**What to do:**
1. Join a world with a Skin that has transparent pixels on the top layer.
2. Select transparent pixels to be emissive in ETF. (Entity Model Features > Textures > Player skin settings > Open skin feature tool > Emissive pixels: ON and "Select pixels") 
3. Enable the blinking feature in ETF. (Entity Model Features > Textures > Player skin settings > Open skin feature tool > Blink: * and Eye position: *)

**Expected result:** Nothing blinks except the blinking feature set by Entity Model Features.

**Actual result:** The transparent pixels that were set to be emissive by ETF are now blinking in sync with the blinking features set by ETF.

**Additional information:** Please note that those pixels are also not rendering the lower layer of the Skin when looking at the Skin from some angles. That means you can see through the entire Skin.
I also made a video:
https://youtu.be/YSZyaPtrNVo

**Software used:**
Minecraft 1.20.2
[ETF] Entity Texture Features v6.2.7
3D Skin Layers v1.7.0
Sodium v0.5.5
Fabric-API v0.91.6

issues.title: [BUG] Entity Texture/Model Features crash on (Neo)Forge servers
issues.body:
**Describe the issue**
When starting a server with ETF or EMF installed, the server crashes.
While there is no need to run these mods on a server, they still should not cause a crash whenever possible.
It happens all the time that modpack authors include these mods in their server files or users copy over the mods folder from their client to the server. According to [the forge documentation](https://docs.minecraftforge.net/en/1.20.x/concepts/sides/#writing-one-sided-mods) one-sided mods should still work on the incorrect side.

> Basically, if your mod is loaded on the wrong side, it should simply do nothing, listen to no events, and so on.

To my understanding you could just remove the line that throws the exception in the [Forge](https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/blob/ETF-Main/forge/src/main/java/traben/entity_texture_features/forge/ETFClientForge.java#L40) and [NeoForge](https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/blob/ETF-Main/neoforge/src/main/java/traben/entity_texture_features/neoforge/ETFClientNeoForge.java) version and it would solve the issue.

issues.title: [BUG] Infinite hang: ETF scans every single texture when ResourceLocation is "minecraft:<empty string>"
issues.body:
## Modmaker here: I tracked down the cause in a debugger. Skip to the end for the problematic area.




**Describe the issue**

- What happened? [e.g. crashed, texture is broken]
  - Turning a villager from "Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn" into a Zombie Villager causes an infinite hang.
- What were you doing when it happened? [e.g. loading the game, playing multiplayer, single-player]
  - Playing multiplayer in a modpack containing about 300 mods. However, the debugger shows that the problem is in an interaction with MCA giving a dummy ResourceLocation and ETF not knowing what to do with that.

**Screenshots**
![dwm_2024-06-03_21-37-52](https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/assets/16433721/4c22d24c-1015-4adb-a378-d7caa061e94b)



**Your setup: (please complete the following information):**

- Minecraft version: 1.20.2
- ModLoader: Forge
- ETF Version: 5.2.3
- Does the issue persist with only ETF installed?
  - Due to the interactions at play here, it is not easy to reproduce with only ETF installed.
[x] Have you checked the FAQ in the Readme, or Discord, to see if it is a known issue? 



### The Problem Area:

https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/blob/2441486fc1ae8bc71038707f16239fd9b3fc50d7/common/src/main/java/traben/entity_texture_features/features/property_reading/TrueRandomProvider.java#L43-L44

From what I can tell, MCA Reborn gives a dummy resource location (`"minecraft" : ""`) to Minecraft because it wants to use its own dynamic texture based on the villager's pre-existing custom skin.  

The problem arises because `ETFDirectory.getDirectoryVersionOf` returns non-null _forever_ when given a resource location like this, even with the suffix added.  When I got to it in IDEA's JVM-attach debugger, `totalTextureCount` was `563133802`.


### The Fix:

https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/blob/2441486fc1ae8bc71038707f16239fd9b3fc50d7/common/src/main/java/traben/entity_texture_features/ETFApi.java#L438-L473

It's pretty easy: at the top of `ETFApi.ETFVariantSuffixProvider#getVariantProviderOrNull`, check if `vanillaIdentifier` is a valid identifier to begin with before matching textures for it.  That or just check if it's empty.  Should fix the issue right up.

issues.title: Custom textures not loading in certain situations
issues.body:
Version of ETF - 1.20.2-5.2.1
Version of EMF - 1.20.2-1.2.3
Used Quilt loader. Of the installed mods, only ETF and EMF

**Describe the issue**

With this mod, some entities with custom names will have vanilla textures, instead of ones specified in .properties. I assume that happens because ETF processes names in .properties that use spaces without ipattern incorrectly. This issue doesn't exist in Optifine.

For example, with this mods, texture of a creeper with:

Name in the game: «Abomination»
name.X=Abomination
Will loaded CORRECTLY

Name in the game: «Flaming Horror»
name.X=Flaming Horror
Will loaded like VANILLA ONE instead of custom

Name in the game: «Colossus of Chaos»
name.X=ipattern:*Colossus of Chaos
Will loaded CORRECTLY

With Optifine textures in all cases are loaded CORRECTLY.

**How to reproduce**
You can download [this](https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/files/14073847/TestTestTest.zip) resource pack, use the same versions of ETF and EMF, and name creepers the same way i mentioned earlier. The Flaming Horror will have a vanilla texture. Then you could open the same world with Optifine and all creepers will have custom textures.

issues.title: [BUG] Large Framerate Drop When Looking at Entities with FreshAnimations Resource Pack and Complimentary Shaders 5.0.1 When PBR Enabled
issues.body:
**Describe the issue**

- Frame rate drops from about 50-60 fps to 5-10 fps when facing a 10x10 fence with 20 cow entities.
- Loaded ETF with default settings, the FreshAnimations resource pack, and Iris and ComplementaryReimagined r5.0.1 shaders, which I believe was a major re-write of that shader pack. Issue isn't seen with ComplementaryReimagined r2.3. Issue isn't seen if PBR is turned off entirely in the shader options. Issue isn't seen if FreshAnimations resource pack is disabled.

**Your setup: (please complete the following information):**

- **Minecraft version:** 1.20.2
- **ModLoader:** Quilt-Loader-0.21.0-1.20.2
- **ETF Version:** 1.20.2-4.5.1
- **Does the issue persist with only ETF installed?:** No, requires both 1) ETF with FreshAnimations resource pack 2) Iris with ComplementaryReimagined r5.0.1. Removing or altering any of those two conditions would resolve it.
- **Have you checked the FAQ in the Readme, or Discord, to see if it is a known issue?:** Yes

**Other information**:
ComplementaryReimagined r5.0.1 shaders seems to have lower performance when displaying entities on screen compared to its r2.3 version, overall, and ETF seems to exacerbate that a lot. Some results:

```
Shader Ver | PBR?     | ETF Ver | FreshAnimations?  | FPS (Avg) | FPS (Facing Entities)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
r2.3       | Enabled  | 4.5.1   | Enabled           | 50-60     | 50-60
r5.0.1     | Enabled  | 4.5.1   | Enabled           | 50-60     | 5-10
r5.0.1     | Disabled | 4.5.1   | Enabled           | 50-60     | 30-40
r5.0.1     | Enabled  | 4.5.1   | Disabled          | 50-60     | 30-40
r5.0.1     | Enabled  | Removed | N/A, ETF Required | 50-60     | 30-40
```

I have a 2020 iMac with a Core i9 and 5700XT and am aware there are likely thermal constraints. I am not ruling out that I am approaching a performance bottleneck of my computer and the combination of this specific shader and ETF is stressing the system too much, but it just seems like to steep of a performance drop to purely blame hardware. I did contact the ComplementaryReimagined team via Discord, and as with all performance issues I've had in the past, an admin responded within just 1-2 minutes saying it's likely my hardware setup without really looking into it. In the past, some unrelated performance issues have definitely been resolved in newer revisions of their shader pack, so I am not sure if they are just giving a boilerplate response.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Disable vanilla emissive entities
issues.body:
In making a few emissive resourcepacks for this mod, I noticed more and more that Mojang have implemented their own emissive behaviour for certain mobs, here is a rough list:

- Allay
- Vex
- Blaze
- Spider eyes
- Enderman eyes
- Magma cube
- Phantom eyes
- Wither
- Beacon/end gateway beam

(There may be more but these are the ones that I noticed)
My suggestion is to add a mod setting that allows disabling this behaviour, allowing for emissive resourcepacks to work on these entities as well.
Unfortunately I am not equipped enough with Java knowledge to attempt this myself, nor to know how difficult this would be, but I think it could add some value to this amazing mod :)

issues.title: Very poor performance (reading from the file system every frame)
issues.body:
It appears as though when looking for texture variants, ETF does a resource manager lookup every frame for every entity to find whether there are available variants.
This essentially means that ETF is __**reducing game performance based on the speed of your hard drive or SSD**__.

A better method would be to resolve available textures during resource reload, and cache those to be checked later during rendering.

Spark profile: [https://spark.lucko.me/z9b0Ohaf0A](https://spark.lucko.me/z9b0Ohaf0A)
Image of relevant performance hit:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43485105/174540415-e2086cfa-3c27-4bc8-b77d-0d9c00907eae.png)

issues.body:
Refer to attached screenshots. ETF seems to cause the Figura player model to render independently of block light and only taking sky light into account, even if it doesn't have access to sky light. In the first image the model is rendering at full brightness despite the absurdly low block light and closed room since sky light is at full brightness. Disabling ETF fixed the crash, but what's weird is that running with *just* ETF does not have the crash. So, clearly, it's an incompatibility of some sort.

After much pain, I finally determined the combination of mods that made this happen. Removing any of the bolded mods fixes the crash:

* Minecraft 1.18.2
* MaLiLib 0.12.1 (required for Litematica)
* **Litematica 0.11.1**
* **LazyDFU 0.1.2**
* **Entity Texture Features 2.6.RC2**

Removing Not Enough Crashes (4.1.4+1.18.2) does not actually stop the crash, but I did check for completeness. I'm also running on the Fabric Loader 0.13.3, but that shouldn't affect this.

This was originally shared on the Litematica repo since that's the mod that directly shows up in the stack trace, but I decided to link this here too in case anyone has any insight on why this might be happening with specifically ETF, since it's very strange that a textures mod would cause this. Note that I do not have this crash on 1.18.1 where I also have these mods installed, in case that helps narrow down the issue:

* Minecraft 1.18.1
* MaLiLib 0.11.8
* Litematica 0.10.4
* LazyDFU 0.1.2
* Entity Texture Features 2.4.1

I strongly suspect that this isn't LazyDFU's fault since it hasn't had any changes since then, and I also shared this issue on the Litematica repo. Once this issue is solved on either side I'll close this issue on all the repos, but I figured I'd share here for visibility.

issues.title: Entity Texture Features [V2.5.3]-[1.18.x]
issues.body:
The random mob properties feature seems to be broken.



[ cow ]
skins.1=4 5 6
biomes.1=badlands wooded_badlands eroded_badlands desert jungle sparse_jungle bamboo_jungle savanna savanna_plateau windswept_savanna swamp
weights.1=100 50 25

skins.2=1 2 3
weights.2=100 50 25



[ pig ]
skins.1=2
biomes.1=badlands wooded_badlands eroded_badlands desert jungle sparse_jungle bamboo_jungle savanna savanna_plateau windswept_savanna swamp

skins.2=1



It works well up to version 2.5.1, but after updating to 2.5.3, this function stops working, the biome filtering function becomes paralyzed, and the weight does not work either.

That is, in all biomes, cows have skins of 1 to 3 with the same probability, and pigs only have skins of 1 in all biomes.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




And I'm just curious, what about a function that displays a rendered mob's head icon like in Xaero's minimap mod, or a function that displays a rendered 3D appearance of a mob in a mob spawn egg tooltip like Inspecio mod? 

At this time, the head icon of the mob that will appear on the minimap is displayed randomly each time. Or sometimes, only villagers have two random textures displayed on the minimap at the same time. Of course, it's not the same as what's worn on an actual villager, it's just random. If you look at the 3 attached minimaps, you can see that the textures of cows and chickens have changed. This is the result of using the same resource pack, but due to some action of the mod, the mob's representative texture changes from time to time. It changes occasionally when reloading the resource pack. And in most cases, it is displayed with a certain specific skin with a high probability. However, when using the random function in the original Optifine of 1.17.1, it was always displayed as the icon of the default skin in the vanilla path without random function applied. 
![2022-03-07_18 11 40 - 복사본](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101512862/158710715-e481fe1f-b0e0-45b6-a67f-678b037e9027.png)
![2022-03-07_23 29 39 - 복사본](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101512862/158710720-e6b3a59e-ea81-457f-95f0-61e281832892.png)
![2022-03-13_01 43 39 - 복사본](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101512862/158710790-f724418f-a880-4980-8861-62991d7c8695.png)
![02](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101512862/158711116-903d4f08-34db-450b-8473-0a6c4e839dac.png)
![03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101512862/158711119-65d24d57-962a-47e5-a083-41561612810f.png)
![01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101512862/158711122-5241afcf-b79d-4154-bcd2-1083289ded98.png)

Also, the rendered 3D mobs displayed in the spawn egg tool appear to have all random textures blinking in sequence at a rate of about 30Hz. The original Optifine 1.18.1 H4 does not have this problem. It is just displayed as a vanilla skin.
![Honeycam 2022-03-13 23-25-19](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/101512862/158709218-a2b63c06-595e-402c-ac93-146a84f75b4f.gif)

But strangely, in the case of ToroHealth mode, there is no problem at all, and the same rendering tooltip as the texture worn by the actual mob is displayed.

One big difference compared to the original Optifine random mob function is that in the original, number 1 means the original skin in the vanilla path, and even if you put cow1 in the random folder, it is not recognized as number 1.

Can the rendering of mobs displayed in other mods like the original Optifine be fixed to skin number 1?

issues.title: Incorrect enumeration of random textures
issues.body:
This was debugged using the John Smith Legacy (v6) for 1.18.1 resource pack.

I noticed that there was a greatly reduced mob variety. It was fairly easy to test with the creeper textures due to their distinctive designs and their modest amount of skins in this pack.  It uses the `assets/minecraft/optifine/mob` path for random textures, and it counts them from index 2 and up. Default textures for entities are present under `assets/minecraft/textures`.

This is what it looks like by default with this mod enabled: 
![2022-02-13_23 12 26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11655762/153775430-a87217de-1e72-4b48-915d-0609c9ef86a1.png)

The skins depicted here are ordered from right to left. Rightmost is the default skin (1), and leftmost is skin 5. However, the skins shown with the mod, from right to left, are actually 3, 4, 3, 3, 1. Something is very wrong.

I tried as an experiment to take the default skin and placed it in the respective folders under `optifine/mob` where the extra skins were, then added `1` as a suffix to the name of each skin. Rebooted the game, and this is the result:
![2022-02-13_20 38 18](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11655762/153775791-4fbb8ad0-c8d2-49f1-8cc4-d12458b52baf.png)

NOW the skins are showing properly. Something is wrong with how the mod is counting the skins, possibly some weird off-by-one situation in the calculations when it checks for an index starting from 2 rather than 1. Below I will list all the creeper skins for reference so you can confirm their order as well:

![creeper1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11655762/153775850-826621e1-424f-4ade-9337-24109e580df0.png)
![creeper2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11655762/153775851-2361a9c4-b3ed-4691-9b28-de8f1a6cac02.png)
![creeper3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11655762/153775853-bf5b15a6-750e-4e2d-9bc7-53427d3e1d74.png)
![creeper4](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11655762/153775854-a6bba159-3e44-48d5-a083-1711d9a0be9d.png)
![creeper5](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11655762/153775855-ccc171ff-c9f8-440c-9146-25f693b0e973.png)

Please have a look into this! I'd like to continue using this mod without having to modify my resource pack to work! :)

issues.title: A Crash With Other Mods
issues.body:
I cloned this repository to my IntelliJ and for test I added some mods including **Sodium**.
Mods List:
- appleskin-fabric-mc1.18-2.2.0.jar
- fabric-api-0.46.2+1.18.jar
- iris-mc1.18.1-1.2.0-pre.jar
- lithium-fabric-mc1.18.1-0.7.7.jar
- modmenu-3.0.1.jar
- phosphor-fabric-mc1.18.x-0.8.1.jar
- sodium-fabric-mc1.18.1-0.4.0-alpha6+build.14.jar

I launched the game by `runClient` and at the first everything was normal. After I entering a world and looking around it suddenly crashed.
So I browse the latest.log and the debug.log and find that:
> java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: 'void net.minecraft.world.chunk.light.ChunkLightProvider.method_15483(long)'

And I find this `void net.minecraft.world.chunk.light.ChunkLightProvider.method_15483(long)` is exactly `void net.minecraft.world.chunk.light.ChunkLightProvider.resetLevel(long id)` because of the method signature.
I guess that Sodium overwrites this class, but I am not sure. I will do more test and update this issue contineously.
